📺 Mr. Inbetween (2018–2021)

Mr. Inbetween follows Ray Shoesmith, a professional hitman living in Australia who struggles to balance his dangerous criminal career with the responsibilities of everyday life. While working as an enforcer for hire, Ray also tries to be a loving father to his young daughter, maintain friendships, and care for his sick brother. His ability to remain calm in violent situations often clashes with the emotional challenges of family, relationships, and personal loyalty. As his criminal activities become increasingly complicated, Ray must navigate dangerous enemies, difficult decisions, and the consequences of his actions. Combining dark humor, intense action, and emotional storytelling, Mr. Inbetween explores family, morality, loyalty, and the complicated life of a man caught between two very different worlds.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Dark Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 8.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Scott Ryan

🏆 Awards: Winner of multiple Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts Awards.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Mr Inbetween is an Australian dark comedy-crime drama television series which premiered on FX on 25 September 2018 in the United States, followed by Fox Showcase in Australia on 1 October 2018. The series is a serialisation of the 2005 feature film The Magician, which was created, written by and starred Scott Ryan as Ray Shoesmith, a hitman for hire balancing his criminal and personal lives. Ryan reprises his lead role and is also the writer for the series, while all episodes are directed by Nash Edgerton. The program was originally commissioned for FX Australia as its first original drama production, but instead launched in Australia on Showcase following the closure of FX Australia between
